summary: One of the 30 founding proprietors of Hudson, NY, its recorder and mayor; John's 3rd cousin 8x removed.
bio:
Path: Elizabeth → Joseph → John (b. 1703, Newport and Providence shipowner) → David. Brother Joseph Lawrence (b. 1729) wrote the first marine insurance policy in Rhode Island (3C8R).

Seventh son of John, son of Joseph, son of William & Elizabeth Smith ([R4-S1]): 3rd cousin 8 times removed. A Providence merchant and patriot, 'the intimate friend of Benjamin Franklin', who named a son after Samuel Adams; moved to Hudson in 1783 as one of its thirty founding proprietors and served as recorder and mayor.
sources: [R4-S1] Thomas Lawrence, Historical Genealogy of the Lawrence Family (1858) (archive.org full text), pp. 55-56 (secondary) https://archive.org/details/historicalgeneal00lawr
